description: Three two-input circuits on one panel: a window comparator, a difference rectifier and a subtractor, all polyphonic

params.text: Sets a voltage width, 0 to 10V, inside which A and B count as equal; it widens the equal gate, narrows the three others, and is taken off the top of both rectifier outputs

inputs.text: The A voltage for the comparator, and the fallback A voltage for the rectifier and the subtractor below when their own A jacks are empty
The B voltage for the comparator, and the fallback B voltage for the rectifier and the subtractor below when their own B jacks are empty
The A voltage for the difference rectifier; with nothing patched it reads the comparator's A jack
The B voltage for the difference rectifier; with nothing patched it reads the comparator's B jack
The A voltage for the subtraction; with nothing patched it reads the rectifier's A jack
The B voltage for the subtraction; with nothing patched it reads the rectifier's B jack

outputs.text: 10V while A plus the window width is below B, 0V otherwise
10V while A minus the window width is above B, 0V otherwise
10V while A and B differ by no more than the window width, 0V otherwise
10V while A and B differ by more than the window width, 0V otherwise
How far A rises above B, with the window width taken off the top; 0V whenever A does not exceed B by more than that width
How far A falls below B, with the window width taken off the top; 0V whenever A is not below B by more than that width
A minus B. The window knob does nothing to this output
